text.p: J.P. Morgan Securities said it downgraded Gateway 2000 Inc to market performer from buy.
-- said Gateway had exceeded the firm's price target.
-- said sees "little room for an earnings upside."
-- said Gateway's growth, while very robust, appears to be trailing that of its major competitors.

-- said Gateway does not have a very bullish view of its future gross margins. Said "In fact, it sees them actually dropping a bit and has given no indication as to when its new initiatives in servers might contribute a mix benefit to the gross margins."

-- said Gateway attributed its second quarter earnings disappointment to the transition to Pentium II in its product line. J.P. Morgan said this "Pentium II issue may not be fully resolved." Said it expects Pentium II revenues to grow gradually beyond the current 15 percent contribution to Gateway's revenues, but said there are other "pieces to the Pentium II puzzle."
-- said believes that Gateway remains an excellent company with a "potent" market position.
